content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Study organisation Financing your studies Scholarships Scholarships A scholarship can offer more than just financial relief. It provides you with a support network, opportunities for professional development and personal advancement. Your social commitment, special life circumstances and your career to date are important factors in the selection process. Good grades are an advantage.
